description: This file defines the Converter interface used for converting objects from one type to another within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: Converter
classes.description: A generic interface for converting objects between source type S and target type T.

methods.name: canConvert
methods.description: Checks if the converter can convert from the provided source class to the target class.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts an object of source type S to target type T.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts an object of source type S to target type T, specifying the target class.

methods.name: getSourceClass
methods.description: Returns the source class type that this converter supports.

methods.name: getTargetClass
methods.description: Returns the target class type that this converter supports.
